variant.author: nainaiowo
variant.changelog: Camera previews retain their names with an unlocked preview suffix and remember movement when switching views or returning from Game camera. Lock preview restores the angle from before previewing. Scene cameras now load movable immediately, with stable identity instead of borrowing a matching session camera's name. Camera Undo/Redo, path restoration and scene rollback preserve preview modes and original angles. Preview state clears on GPose exit and is never serialized into saved files. Scene placement remains character-relative by default; the separate camera-path placement option is unchanged.
variant.description:
A Gposing and scene tool.
